messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 我目前無法直接查詢即時交通資訊。若您想了解紐約市（New York, NY）的最新路況，建議使用像 Google Maps、Waze 或當地交通局的實時交通服務。這些平台會顯示主要道路、擁堵程度、事故或施工等資訊，並提供最佳行車路線與預估到達時間。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to use the geocode_address function to get the location. But we don't have a specific address; they want traffic status for New York. We can interpret that as "New York City". So we should call geocode_address with address "New York City" or "New York, NY". Then we can provide traffic info. But we don't have real-time data. We can respond that we cannot fetch real-time traffic. But we can provide general info. According to policy, we should not claim to have real-time data. We can say we can't provide real-time traffic. We can suggest using Google Maps or Waze. Also we can provide typical traffic patterns. So answer in Chinese.
